instruction: Market hall conversion from init.ifc. Open C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Archicad and use C:\Users\user\Desktop\init_plan.png and C:\Users\user\Desktop\init_section.png as references while converting it into the required one-storey market hall. The init file supplies a small starting shell and must be expanded with the required final spaces and roof elements. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. Keep the shaped model envelope approximately within min 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 and max 32.0, 10.0, 4.6, with 0.5 m tolerance. The IFC must have unique GlobalId values, exactly one building storey, exactly fourteen IfcSpace zones, at least four walls, at least one slab, and at least three roof elements. Put every zone on the single storey and name the zones STALL-1, STALL-2, STALL-3, STALL-4, STALL-5, STALL-6, STALL-7, STALL-8, STALL-9, STALL-10, AISLE, COLD-STORE, DRY-STORE, and ARCADE. Equivalent Archicad or IFC export internals, object names, relationship structure, materials, and property sets may vary; the required result is the stated BIM model and deliverables, not a byte-for-byte copy of the teacher IFC. [Software] Launch ArchiCAD with `C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad` (adjust version/path).
